text_block_list.text:
And that's that for the Japanese Oaks!
Man, that
was a blast!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон really brought in the
energy again! I
can't wait for the Shuka
Sho!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
I think she's got some new merchandise
out. We
should go have a look!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
With two-thirds of the Tiara tour under
her belt,
Hishi Amazon is starting to
become a household
name.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Woo, that was some one-on-one all right! That's the Oaks for you—all those racers out there were monsters!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks! But we're not done yet!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
That second crown is definitely going to
Narita
Brian at the Japanese Derby next
week. This is no
time to get complacent.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna give the Shuka Sho everything
I've got,
so you'd better keep up with
me, Teach!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
It's time to kick our training up a notch
for the
Shuka Sho!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
